author: XTREMPANDA
body:
I apparently got ban by Straightened for Rudeness/Spam

I am really confused and I'd like to have more information and reason why of my punishment.

Thank you.



Also I'd like to add that I was talking to Straightened and I though he was managing the situation and that everything was okay. As far as I am aware it seems that he lied to me and made fun of us, and I do not feel that he is in the best position to make fun of us, as I felt offended. I hope to receive apologize as I am apologizing myself if I offended anyone with something I am still not sure I did wrong.

title: Appeal: 616433

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Straightened temp-banned you due to your chat behaviour on the server. If you're confused about what is and is not allowed then I suggest you thoroughly read the rules page. You had already been warned and kicked on the same day so this infraction was to be expected, considering you continued.

In addition, this temp-ban has already expired so you're free to play on the server now (as long as you abide by the rules). Feel free to send an email to support@avicus.net if you wish to make a complaint about a staff member.

Regards,
Mango_
